text:
Maria T.: Heads-up — planning to start a canary for model v4 next Tue. Thinking percent ramp (1% -> 10% -> 50%) across US/EU regions, leaving APAC out for now. Need final guardrails and ops checklist.

Kevin: SGTM. Do we have the feature-flag names and rollout job ready? Also what rollback metrics are we watching?

Maria T.: Flag names: `inference.model.v4.canary` (percent) and `inference.model.v4.region` (enum). Rollout job is queued in CI, will kick off after approvals. Rollback metrics: p50 latency, 5xx rate, and a user-facing quality regressions counter hooked into evals. Thresholds proposed: p50 +50ms, 5xx > 0.5% -> rollback.

Sasha: Can we include a short delay between percent steps? e.g., 2h at 1%, 4h at 10% (monitoring), then 24h at 50% before full flip. Also add canary-only logging so we can trace sessions.

Lisa (oncall): Oncall here — please add an automated alert to PagerDuty for the 5xx threshold and a slack webhook to #incidents. If APAC is excluded, make sure routing policy doesn't accidentally forward traffic via edge region.

Maria T.: Good call. I'll add PD + #incidents hook. For routing: we'll set policy `region_preference: match` and explicitly deny APAC in the canary scope. Config snippet I'm planning to use:

```json
{ "flag": "inference.model.v4.canary", "strategy": "percent", "steps": [1, 10, 50], "step_delay": [7200, 14400, 86400], "rollback_conditions": { "p50_latency_ms": 50, "error_rate_pct": 0.5, "quality_regression": true }, "regions": ["us", "eu"] }
```

Kevin: Looks good. Two quick asks: 1) add a KV cache warm-up so cold starts don't spike p50; 2) ensure model variant fallback is documented (v3 fallback when v4 fails).

Sasha: I'll add the cache warm-up hook in the serving runtime. Also proposing a temporary sampling of 10% of canary requests with full model output recorded for offline evals.

Maria T.: Adding both. Also will create a short playbook (qa checklist + rollback steps) and post to #eng-runtime before Monday.

deploy-bot: deploy job `canary/model-v4/ramp` scheduled by Maria T. for 2029-06-12T08:00Z. Status: pending approvals.

Lisa (oncall): Please @mention me in the approvals so I can remove PD on-call if this is a low-risk push.

Maria T.: Will do. Last question: any objections to enabling the percent flag as a soft start (no forced sampling) so dev teams can opt-in for early validation?

Kevin: Fine by me — prefer soft start for first 48h. Add a telemetry tag `soft_start:true`.

Sasha: +1. Will set sampling header and start trace tags.

Maria T.: Great. I'll finalize config, add the PD/Webhook, upload the playbook, and tag the approvals. Will follow up after first step. :thumbsup:
